readout_other: Self-reported meditative depth and subjective intensity (1:5 button presses every ~4 min)
direction_notes: In experts, CN-FUS and PCC-FUS raised reported meditative depth relative to sham at several timepoints, mostly after FUS offset; novices showed no significant change in depth, and ventral anterior insula FUS lowered intensity in novices.

timing.protocol_description: 12 minutes of FUS beginning about minute 12 of a 1-hour Vipassana meditation; the figure legend describes 10-second on/off blocks. PCC received 12 minutes to one location; bilateral targets (CN, ventral anterior insula) received 6 minutes to each hemisphere sequentially. Sham-FUS in the fourth session.
